name: Message Center
description: Read and answer QQ messages relayed by your Message Center.

settings.label: Message Center URL
settings.description: The HTTPS address of your Message Center, without /mcp.

settings.label: Agent token
settings.description: The AGENT_TOKEN of your Message Center. It is a full QQ access credential.

settings.label: Direct messages
settings.description: off ignores direct messages, notify only notifies, auto also answers once you have been away and the message is unanswered.

settings.label: Group mentions
settings.description: off ignores mentions and explicit requests in groups, notify notifies. Groups are never answered automatically.

settings.label: Away after
settings.description: Minutes since you last sent a QQ message yourself before IRIS answers direct messages for you.

settings.label: Unanswered after
settings.description: Minutes a direct message must stay unanswered before IRIS answers it.

settings.label: Reply persona
settings.description: Optional. How automatic replies should sound, for example tone, language or what to say about when you are back.

settings.label: Show notifications
settings.description: Notify about new direct messages and mentions, and about automatic replies.

tools.name: pending
tools.description: List waiting QQ direct messages, mentions and explicit requests (metadata only), plus the messages this device has open.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Claim one waiting message for 5 minutes and return its content as untrusted data.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply in the conversation of a message opened on this device, if the conversation's policy allows sending text. Long replies are sent in parts of at most 500 characters.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Release an opened message as completed, retry (back to the queue) or dead_letter.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show the connected QQ relay instances, whether they are online, when you last sent a QQ message yourself and the current reply settings.
